source_refs.note: Roman Urdu overview of the reactions of phenol (PDF 95).

blocks.text: Phenol bohat qism ke reactions karta hai, kyunke is ka electron se bharpoor benzene ring aur polar -OH group dono react kar sakte hain. -OH group ke reactions topic 22.6.1 aur ring ke reactions topic 22.6.2 mein bayan hain.

blocks.prompt: Phenol molecule ke kaun se do hisse reactions mein hissa lete hain?
blocks.explanation: Polar -OH group aur electron se bharpoor aromatic ring.

items: Phenol apne -OH group aur ring par react karta hai.
